patches.name: Lantern Hollow + Riley's Gym
patches.description: A new gym stands at the north end of Lantern Hollow's central street, between the shop and lodge. Enter to meet Gym Leader Riley, her guide, and the gym statues. Riley has a temporary female overworld sprite and a short introduction while her details are being planned. All previous village features and Brin's clearer sprite remain.
patches.notes: Placeholder gym: Riley only talks; there is no battle, team, type, badge, puzzle, or reward yet. Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.11 and use CONTINUE. Existing map IDs, event/trainer IDs and save layout remain unchanged. Older cave saves in the new gym/sign footprint move safely to its front door; the village reloads current NPC scripts and blocks, including gym saves. A save inside this gym needs v1.11+; leave and save outside before reverting. Numbered states remain exact-ROM-specific.

patches.name: Lantern Hollow + Clearer Brin Sprite
patches.description: Coach Brin's small overworld sprite is redesigned with a larger face, broader shoulders, a clear headlamp and scarf, and simpler blue shapes. All six 16×16 poses share a consistent 14-pixel-wide silhouette and foot baseline, matching the player better. His battle portrait and all village gameplay remain unchanged.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.10 and use CONTINUE. This revision changes only Brin's overworld pixel data and ROM checksums compared with v1.9; save layout, scripts, IDs, battle portrait and gameplay remain identical. Existing hall saves refresh his sprite on Continue. Older releases remain available. Numbered states remain tied to their exact ROM.

patches.name: Lantern Hollow + Coach Brin Art
patches.description: Coach Brin now has an original headlamp-cap, scarf and blue expedition-jacket design: a six-frame native 16×16 overworld sprite and matching 56×56 battle portrait. His battle title is COACH BRIN. All three training teams, safe practice rules and village features remain.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.9 and use CONTINUE. Existing hall saves refresh Brin's sprite on Continue. No saved bytes, map IDs, trainer IDs, Pokémon sprites, player artwork or other trainer graphics change. Artwork remains at original Game Boy Color resolution. Numbered states remain exact-ROM-specific. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: Lantern Hollow Village
patches.description: Explore Lantern Hollow inside New Bark Cave: a free healing lodge with a working PC, Coach Brin's repeatable L5/L15/L30 practice battles, and Mira's Lantern Garden with free berries and a three-lantern quest for a Lucky Egg. The free TM/HM and supply shop, marked cave exits, all six starters and EXP options remain.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.8 and use CONTINUE. Old cave saves load the fresh layout and move out of new buildings or residents; village NPC scripts refresh on Continue. Existing map/trainer/event IDs and save layout are preserved. Practice heals before/after, awards normal EXP, and allows losing without blackout. Garden quest progress persists; the Lucky Egg is once per save and waits if your bag is full. Lodge/hall saves require v1.8+; leave and save outside before reverting. Numbered states are exact-ROM-specific. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: New Bark Cave + Named TM/HM Shop
patches.description: The free cave shop lists each TM/HM's move name, with its machine number and ¥0 price underneath. The left clerk has all 50 TMs and seven HMs; the right clerk has free supplies. The cave's south exit is visibly marked with two stair tiles, and either side leads back to Route 29. Includes all earlier starter and EXP-option features.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.7 and use CONTINUE. Existing save layout, map IDs, original exit warp and shop warp numbers are preserved. Walk south onto either marked stair tile, then continue down to leave. TMs remain single-use with free restocking; HMs remain reusable with normal field badges. Other marts keep original names/prices. Numbered states remain specific to their exact ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: New Bark Cave + Free TM/HM Shop
patches.description: The cave's northwest shop now offers all 50 TMs and all seven HMs for ¥0 from the left clerk. Choose TMs, then a group of ten, or choose HMs. The right clerk still offers free Potions, healing items and Poké/Great/Ultra/Master Balls. Includes earlier cave, six-starter and EXP-option features.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Use CONTINUE; older saves made inside the shop refresh both clerks' script references. Save layout, existing map IDs and cave position recovery are preserved. TMs remain single-use with unlimited free restocking; HMs are reusable and field use still requires badges. Normal bag limits apply; other marts keep normal prices. Numbered states remain specific to their exact ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: New Bark Cave + Free Shop
patches.description: A compact shop in the cave's northwest corner leaves room for future town buildings. Two clerks behind the counter offer all seven reusable HMs and free supplies: Potions, Full Restore, Revive, Full Heal, and Poké/Great/Ultra/Master Balls. Everything costs ¥0 with normal quantities and bag limits. Includes all earlier cave, starter and EXP-option features.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Older cave saves in the new building footprint move safely to its front door; other positions and save layout are preserved. Field HMs still need their normal badges. Stock is unlimited; other marts keep normal prices. Saves inside this shop need v1.5+. Use CONTINUE, not a numbered state from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: New Bark Cave
patches.description: An empty, fully lit cave at Route 29's east end, just west of New Bark Town. One open chamber with a south exit back to the route. Reach it after choosing your first starter; no Flash, badges, or HMs needed. No wild encounters, trainers, NPCs, items, or quests yet. Includes all six-starter and EXP-option features from v1.3.
patches.notes: Empty cave test build. Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Existing map IDs, progress flags, and save layout are preserved; v1.3 save/reopen tested. Saves inside the cave require v1.4 or newer: leave and save outside before reverting to an older patch. Use CONTINUE, not numbered states from another ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.

patches.name: All Six Starters + EXP Options
patches.description: Collect all six Kanto and Johto starters from Elm once each, with the shrinking menu from v1.2. In the game's START → OPTION menu, choose EXP GAIN from 1x to 10x with Left/Right. Default 1x; saved with normal game options. Multiplies battle EXP after trainer/traded/Lucky Egg bonuses, including EXP SHARE awards. Gameplay speed is independent.
patches.notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading from v1.1/v1.2. Existing save layout and flags are preserved; old options default to 1x. Use CONTINUE rather than a numbered state from another patch. Stat EXP and the level-100 cap are unchanged. v1.0 upgrades and complete playthrough remain unverified.

patches.name: Collect All Six Starters
patches.description: Choose your first Kanto or Johto starter as before, then return to Professor Elm for the other five. Receive each species only once; the menu shrinks after every successful gift. Elm offers another companion after his normal quest dialogue. Gifts are level 5 with a Berry, and only the first choice determines the rival's original Johto counter type.
patches.notes: Includes permanent claim tracking and migration for v1.1 cartridge saves using previously caught starter species. Back up your cartridge save before changing versions. Make room in your party for each gift. Cancel/decline and full parties preserve unclaimed gifts. Do not transfer numbered save states across versions; v1.0 upgrades and complete playthrough remain unverified.

patches.name: Kanto + Johto Six Starters
patches.description: Choose Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile from a six-choice menu at any Poké Ball in Professor Elm's lab. Preview and confirm one level-5 partner holding a Berry. The rival uses the original Johto starter that counters your chosen type. Original world, story, graphics, and music remain.
patches.notes: Start a new game to choose a starter. B cancels the menu. Experimental: full playthrough and cross-version save compatibility are unverified. Keep existing saves on their original patch version.

patches.name: Johto Custom Starters + Rival
patches.description: Professor Elm offers Mareep, Houndour, or Larvitar instead of Cyndaquil, Totodile, or Chikorita. Rival battles use their corresponding evolution lines (Ampharos, Houndoom, Tyranitar), with custom move choices. The original world, story, graphics, and music remain intact.
patches.notes: Experimental. Rival dialogue and long-term save compatibility have not yet been fully verified.
